en: Letters ride along the belt. Each has a coloured stamp.
Swipe (or drag) a letter down into the mail bag with the same colour.
Wrong bag, or a letter falls off the end of the belt: you lose a heart. 3 hearts and it is over.
Sort in a row to build your streak multiplier.
The belt speeds up and more bags open, forever. Later, stamps get spots too!
